title: Service credit rebalance & runway cushion — Nov 2026 (working sheet)
content:
Purpose
Quick working sheet to evaluate rebalancing of customer service credits, temporary reallocation of marketing credits, and an operational runway cushion exercise tied to three pricing-up / cost-up scenarios. Goal: preserve >=9 months runway without immediate headcount reduction while prioritizing Dedicated renewals and enterprise customers.

Executive snapshot (working numbers)
- Current cash runway (base burn): 14.2 months (as of Oct mrr + committed reserves)
- Monthly net burn: $4.3M
- Service-credit liability (deferred credits outstanding): $24.5M face value, redeemable over next 18 months (variable redemption curves)
- Current hiring plan (Q4–Q2): +18 hires (mix below) costing ~ $0.85M/month incremental run-rate after ramp

Headcount phasing (proposed conservative rearrangement)
- Freeze immediate non-customer-facing roles for 8 weeks (incubator, growth analytics non-core)
- Prioritize hires: 6 ML infra / serving engineers; 4 SRE; 2 Sales Engineers; 6 Customer Success (stretch, but phased)
- Phased ramp: hire 50% in Q4, remainder in Q1 to smooth cash hit

Pricing sensitivity scenarios (impact on monthly revenue and required mitigations)
Assumptions: baseline MRR = $11.6M; elasticity approximations from prior price tests.
- Scenario A: ASP +10% (select enterprise tiers only) -> revenue +4.2% net (churn 0.8%); runway +0.6 months
- Scenario B: ASP +20% (applied to reserved/dedicated offerings) -> revenue +7.5%; churn 2.4% concentrated in mid-market -> runway +1.1 months
- Scenario C: Cost side shock (GPU spot cost +30%) -> gross margin drop 6.7 p.p.; runway -3.4 months without offset

Service-credit rebalancing options (to smooth liability realization)
1) Offer 12-month extended redemption for 60% of outstanding credits (incentive: 2 months extended top-up credits on future purchases). Expected immediate cash relief: $6.5M over 3 months.
2) Convert small credit holders (<$25k) to promotional coupons (one-time) to reduce admin friction — low revenue impact, reduces liability by ~ $1.3M.
3) Negotiate deferred settlement with top 10 enterprise partners (custom QPs) — target $8M shift from 0–6 month redemptions to 6–12 month curve. Requires legal/CS signoff.

Headcount sensitivity table (notes)
- Preserve core Serving Runtime and SRE hires; delay 60% of growth/experiment hires.
- If Scenario C occurs, target 12–15% temporary contractor conversion cut (mostly non-critical infra adjuncts) to recover ~ $0.9M/mo.

Combined mitigation playbook (order of ops)
- Immediate (0–6 weeks): implement hiring freeze for non-essential roles, implement option 2 (small-holder conversion), and run targeted pricing lift A on 15% of enterprise accounts (low churn likelihood).
- Near-term (6–12 weeks): launch service-credit extension campaign (option 1) and negotiate enterprise deferrals (option 3). Legal/Account execs: high-touch outreach required.
- Contingency (if GPU costs spike >25% or revenue delta negative): institute temporary contractor drawdown + pause Q1 non-critical hiring tranche.

Metrics to track (dashboard notes)
- Weekly redemption velocity by cohort (YTD credits outstanding, redemption % by bucket)
- MRR impact of pricing experiments (cohort A/B test results) — track 7/30/90 day churn deltas
- GPU spot and committed cost delta vs forecast (daily ping)
- Hiring ramp actual vs planned (weekly cadence)

Open questions / TODOs
- Legal: what constraints exist on unilateral redemption-term changes? (JH to confirm)
- Sales: recommended account segmentation for targeted price lift (Liam P) — list of 60 candidate accounts needed by 11/18
- Finance: model rebuilt with daily redemption velocity sensitivity (Sofia M)

Notes to self (rough)
- Prefer to avoid headcount cuts; runway cushion is achievable with a mix of credit rebalancing + modest pricing moves + contractor reductions if Scenario C occurs.
- Communication: prep two comms decks (internal ppl ops + external sales/enterprise-facing) before any customer campaign.

Appendix (quick numbers snapshot)
- Cash: $61.0M (incl. committed reserves)
- Monthly opex baseline w/ hiring plan: $4.3M -> projected $5.15M with full Q4 hires; target keep <= $4.8M via phasing
- Target runway under combined plan: 9.5–13.2 months depending on scenario outcomes

-- END WORKING SHEET (comments inline welcome) --
